description: Today I helped to raise funds for the Charles Regional Medical Center Foundation Medical Center's new Julie and Bill Dotson Center for Breast Health by purchasing two VIP tickets. The event was a great cause to support as well as a chance to meet upstanding members of the community. The food and wine were top notch and allowed me to discuss the issues with many friendly voters. Above all else I had the honor of getting the chance to shake the hand of our State's Lt. Governor Boyd Rutherford.
title: James Ashburn helps to raise funds for the new Julie and Bill Dotson Center for Breast Health.
